subject: How to cut  a portion of the axis.

messages.author: 20b73f4748706290
messages.subject: How to cut  a portion of the axis.
parts:
Hello:

I have a x-y type plot graph with x-axis scaled from 0 - 600, but most
of my data is in the middle of the scale
from 0-14 and 550-600. How can I cut the middle (from 14-550) of the
scale so that the graph will more focus on the two portion at the end.

Thanks

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: How to cut a portion of the axis.
parts:
Hi:

You can't. Axis breaking is not supported in ggplot2. For that kind of graphics manipulation,
look into package plotrix; I believe the function is axis.break. It works with base graphics.

Dennis
